subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: rest duration
fact: A long rest precedes assigned tasks.
source_quote: After a long rest, before you go on your assigned tasks.

subject: grey ooze count
fact: A grey ooze is present in the pool. That’s how the waste gets processed.
source_quote: Sethir said there is a grey ooze in the pool. That’s how the waste gets processed.

subject: loot storage
fact: The characters' stuff is in the chest in Ilvara’s room.
source_quote: I know where our stuff is. It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room.

subject: prisoner awakening
fact: At least one or more of the prisoners wakes in a cold sweat from nightmares after every rest.
source_quote: At least one or more of the prisoners wakes in a cold sweat from these nightmares after every rest

subject: underdark environment
fact: The Underdark has insufficient resources or space for anyone.
source_quote: This is the Underdark. There is not enough resources or space for anyone.

subject: drow leadership
fact: The Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself.
source_quote: The Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself.

subject: drow behavior
fact: Other Drow would taunt if they had the characters' stuff.
source_quote: And if any other Drow had our stuff, they would taunt us.

subject: trust dynamics
fact: People tend to distrust outsiders and view them as a resource to be used.
source_quote: People tend to distrust outsiders and view them as a resource to be used.

subject: deal acceptance
fact: The dwarf's deal is accepted.
source_quote: Your deal is accepted.

subject: sleep disturbance
fact: Everyone’s sleep in the slave pen is troubled and fitful, filled with strange dreams and disturbing images.
source_quote: Everyone’s sleep in the slave pen is troubled and fitful, filled with strange dreams and disturbing images.

subject: tunnel maze
fact: Characters wander lost through endless mazes of tunnels.
source_quote: characters wander lost through endless mazes of tunnels.

subject: oily tentacles
fact: Oily tentacles slide to brush up against them.
source_quote: Oily tentacles slide to brush up against them

subject: buzzing and howling
fact: A great buzzing and howling rises in the distance.
source_quote: a great buzzing and howling rises in the distance.

subject: suppurating wounds
fact: Suppurating wounds burst open in clouds of spores or crawling masses of maggots or insects.
source_quote: Suppurating wounds burst open in clouds of spores or crawling masses of maggots or insects.
